description: In combination with `piClim-control`, quantifies present-day tropospheric ozone effective radiative forcing (ERF). Same as `piClim-control`, except anthropogenic non-CH4 tropospheric O3 precursor (NMVOCs, CO, NOx) emissions use present-day values (2021 values for CMIP7). Methane uses present-day values in the chemistry scheme only (to capture CH4-driven O3 production) and remains at 1850 values in the radiation scheme.
